about_the_game:
Feed the cats, conquer the islands, and upgrade your delicious creations!

In the world of Chubby Cats, the cats are not only hungry but also incredibly picky! Your mission is to place various islands, collect ingredients, cook dishes, and satisfy their demands within a limited time. As you progress through the levels, you'll face even greater challenges!

🟢 Creative island placement with endless strategy!

Strategically place different-shaped islands on the map, allowing them to interact and generate various ingredients! You need precise positioning to maximize production and keep all the cats happy and full.

🟡 Rotate & combine to craft unique dishes!

Special cats can help you rotate islands, altering resource connections and unlocking new possibilities! Additionally, by skillfully combining ingredients, you can upgrade basic food into gourmet meals—for example, turning an apple into a caramelized apple—making the cats even happier and earning higher scores!

🔴 Hungry customer cats will test your speed and decision-making!

Cats have limited patience. If they wait too long, they'll get angry and leave, costing you valuable points! How will you manage your time, fulfill orders, and pull off incredible combos before the countdown ends? This is what separates experts from beginners!

🟣 Every map is a brand-new challenge!

From vast oceans to treacherous reefs, each map offers unique mechanics and constraints. Watch out for special "traps"—one wrong move can throw off your entire layout! You'll need to adapt quickly or find the most efficient way to clear obstacles.

🎯 Game Features

✅ Innovative placement gameplay – Arrange block-shaped islands to create the best combinations.

✅ Time & strategy combined – Place, rotate, and merge islands within the time limit to test your decision-making skills.

✅ Adorable cat characters – They're not just customers; chef cats will also help you craft gourmet meals!

✅ Carefully designed levels – From beginner-friendly to high-difficulty challenges, every level brings a fresh experience.

✅ Challenge mode – Star-rating challenges for true master chefs—can you collect all the stars?

Are you ready for the challenge? Feed these hungry cats and become the ultimate feline master chef!
